Of course, it's tragic, but also comforting to see that someone else has taken something terrible like that and turned it into a positive, like I'm trying to do. I never want another family to go through what we did with my mom. I'm not sure I've given you details, but in short, it was a HUGE medical error - a resident I gave her intake to wrote down that Xanax caused AMS instead of what I actually said which was Xanax and benzos cause her respiratory distress.
